  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r}
ds_patches %>%
  filter(trophic_type == "heterotrophic",
         flow == "absolute",
         metaecosystem == "no") %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = day,
      y = bioarea_per_volume,
      group = interaction(day, patch_size_ml),
      color = patch_size_ml
    )
  ) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = resource_flow_days,
    linetype = resource_flow_line_type,
    color = resource_flow_line_color,
    size = resource_flow_line_size
  ) +
  labs(
    x = x_axis_date, 
    y = y_axis_patch_bioarea,
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = legend_position
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             color = zero_line_colour,
             linetype = zero_line_line_type,
             size = zero_line_size)
```
